questions.answerReference:
*a. The force reaches a maximum static peak before motion, then drops to a lower kinetic force while sliding.
b. Kinetic friction is always larger than maximum static friction.
c. Static and kinetic friction are zero once an applied force is present.
d. Adding mass changes the material's friction coefficients in direct proportion to mass.
